title: Three Terms and One Short Dial
subtitle: 物理声学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 物理声学（科学与技术·物理与声学）
meta: 主题语境：物理声学（科学与技术·物理与声学）　|　核心词汇：frequency　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 frequency 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the engineer ① set a frequency that no student in the lab would have named, and he said the setting was the whole of the term. The ② frequency, meaning the rate itself and not the wave, ran three terms and stayed unnamed in the book; a frequency, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ frequency in that lab had the same short dial beside it, and the ④ frequency at the far bench, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A frequency, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the engineer said the naming is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the frequency was the whole of the matter, meaning the repetition and not the rate. The ⑥ frequency, meaning the repetition and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; frequency, he said, is either something you set or the only word that means both a rate and a repetition. He said the repetition is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ frequency had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short dial. The ⑧ frequency of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in March, was one lab and three terms of naming; frequency, he said, is either the one at the far bench or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ frequency I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ frequency, my mother said in 1977, is the only one that improves by being named; every frequency, she said, is a repetition that has agreed to look like a rate. She said the repetition was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 频率（指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 频率（指那一个本身，与波形相对）
C. 固定搭配：set a frequency 设定一个频率
D. n. 频率（指留给孩子们的那一档）
E. n. 频率（抽象总称，指一间实验室的调频之事）
F. n. 频率（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一个）
G. n. 频繁；屡次发生（the frequency of，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 频繁（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: set a frequency that no student in the lab would have named
The frequency, meaning the rate itself and not the wave
the frequency at the far bench

answers.why: set a frequency 意为“设定一个频率”，1966 年那位工程师设定了一个实验室里没有一位学生肯说出名字的频率。
frequency 意为“频率”，指那一个本身而不是波形，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
frequency 意为“频率”，指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一个矮矮的刻度盘。
frequency 意为“频率”，指留给孩子们的那一档，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
frequency 意为“频繁、屡次发生”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这种频繁就是那件事的全部。
frequency 意为“频繁”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那个频率，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
frequency 意为“频率”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一个，到 1973 年这一个成了计划里的一行。
frequency 意为“频率”，工程师三月写道，整件事的调频之事是一间实验室和三个学期的说出名字。
frequency 意为“频率”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一个，1975 年结束了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一个。
frequency 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，一个频率是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
